about_the_game:
🐈 Cats, fish, and endless meow-suspicion.

Among Paws is a pastel-colored, humorous social deduction game.
Each night, someone steals the fish...
When morning comes, all the cats gather around the table with one question:
“Who did it?”

But be careful!
Accuse the wrong cat, and the thief enjoys a delicious feast.
Find the real thief, and the innocent cats share the fish instead!

The first cat to reach 5 kg wins the game.
In short: You either grow fat as a hero... or as a criminal! 😼

🌙 Gameplay Loop

  • Night:
    Everyone wakes up at different times. Thieves steal the fish, some cats may peek for clues.

  • Morning:
    Innocents discuss, thieves bluff, and chaos unfolds.

  • Voting:
    The majority decides who looks guilty.

    • If the chosen cat is the real thief → Innocents win, share the fish, and gain weight.

    • If the chosen cat is innocent → Thieves win, eat the fish, and gain weight.

  • Weight Gain:
    Whoever wins eats the fish — and their belly gets a little bigger.

  • Check the Scale:
    The first cat to reach 5 kg becomes the ultimate champion!

No eliminations, no waiting — every round counts, and every belly matters.
Talk, deceive, accuse, and meow your way to victory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: 🎮 “Who stole the fish? Guess wrong and the thief feasts, guess right and you grow your belly!” A cozy yet suspicious 4–8 player party game where sneaky cats steal fish at night and accuse each other in the morning.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
